$comment: Approved DIRECT dependencies. Activate with --approved=<this file> or by copying the 'approved' array into <repo>/.deps-policy.json. Bootstrap with: depcheck --approved=approved.json --seed-approved. Name-level by default; add "version" (or "versions") to require a fresh approval on every bump. Transitive deps are not name-gated — a 500-entry allowlist rots into rubber-stamping, and hashes (--require-hashes / lock integrity) are what actually pin the bytes.
